institutions.name: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland

requirement.applicantContext: Applicants classified by RCSI Dublin as non-EU school leavers, for September 2027. The same overall minimum applies to both tracks.
requirement.subjectNotes: Take six or more subjects, including three at HL and three at SL. Mathematics AA and AI are both accepted. Five-year track: HL chemistry at 5 or above and HL biology, physics or mathematics. If using HL mathematics with chemistry, also take SL biology or physics. Six-year track: include English, mathematics and at least one of HL chemistry, biology or physics.
requirement.conditions: All IB subject exams must be taken in two consecutive academic years. RCSI excludes repeat exams outside that period.
